Ghost Slice converts sample rates with r8brain-free-src (Aleksey Vaneev), which includes Takuya Ooura's FFT package.
r8brain-free-src: https://github.com/avaneev/r8brain-free-src tag version-6.5 (commit 3c930bf6825c0cfea4a813210c83b1a650c820b5)
